title: Fix the List Merge
description: The program should combine two lists into one flat list of numbers. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], a single flat list.
actualProblem: append() adds its argument as one single element, so the entire more_numbers list gets nested inside numbers as [1, 2, 3, [4, 5, 6]] instead of being merged.
explanation: extend() adds each element of the given iterable individually to the list, while append() adds the whole argument as a single new element. Merging two lists requires extend(), not append().
